name: CFG When: scheduled scale inside a window (megapack)
plain: Sets the guidance scale per step from a shape that runs across a window [start_percent, end_percent], with the window edges read from the model's own percent-to-sigma map. Shapes are constant, Wang linear/cosine up and down, V and Lambda (average kept at cfg), a TV-CFG middle peak, a Beta pdf, C2FG exponential growth and a CADS ramp, with an optional floor. Outside the window it gives the conditional prediction alone (and drops the unconditional pass), or runs the rest of the megapack chain at the base or a fixed scale, or plain CFG with the other stages off. Surprise: shape progress is measured across the window's own steps, while the C2FG and CADS shapes follow the noise level t = sigma/(1+sigma) rather than progress.
math:
Symbols: w̄ base scale (sampler cfg or the mix node's scale); p progress through the window's steps (0 first, 1 last); t noise level = σ/(1+σ) (eps models) or σ (flow); σ_hi = percent_to_sigma(start), σ_lo = percent_to_sigma(end).
Inside (σ_lo ≤ σ ≤ σ_hi): w = max(shape(w̄,p,t), floor), then the chain at w.
 linear_up 1+2(w̄−1)p; linear_down 1+2(w̄−1)(1−p); cosine_up 1+(w̄−1)(1−cos πp); cosine_down 1+(w̄−1)(1+cos πp); tv_cfg triangle peaking at a (area-normalized on the grid); beta_pdf w̄·Beta(p;a,b); c2fg_exp w̄·e^{a(1−t)}; cads_ramp w̄·γ_CADS(t;a,b).
Outside: cond → x̂ = x̂_c (uncond pass dropped if skip_uncond); base → chain at w̄; fixed → chain at outside_scale; plain → x̂ = x̂_u + w̄(x̂_c − x̂_u).

props.extra_model_calls: 0; saves the uncond pass outside a 'no guidance' window
props.params: shape=constant, start_percent=0, end_percent=1, outside=no guidance (conditional), outside_scale=1, floor=0, shape_a=-1, shape_b=-1 (shape defaults), skip_uncond_outside=true
